This has been, hands down, the worst experience I have ever had with a product I ordered from Etsy. 

The process of downloading this planner is terrible. I have not been able to upload it to Goodnotes & the website "forces" you to download to an email address. It's challenging just to receive the file because it is so big that the server times out.  When it finally was uploaded to GoodNotes, it took forever to load.  And then, when it finally loaded, the formatting was for A4 sized paper.  To make matters worse, when I clicked on the links to move from month to month, I was sent to the wrong page.  For instance, I clicked on "April" and was sent to the "Monthly Goals" page.  Cannot begin to express how frustrating and EXPENSIVE the overall experience has been. At this point, I would like a total refund.

I can't get anything to download. I read the FAQ, but that wasn't the slightest bit helpful. I messaged the seller, hopefully I get a response. Right now I've paid $19.99 for something I can't use.

Took OVER A MONTH to receive this item and in the mean time the seller was absolutely ZERO help. I asked about having one of the designs listed as a PDF printed and they only responded with an automated message. I'm not sure if this is just a big box store posing as an 'artist' on Etsy or what, but it was impossible to reach a human...only got automated responses saying they are too busy to actually respond to questions. Then when I reached out about where my item was because of the super long shipping, all I got for a response was a screen shot of the tracking label.  This is the first negative review I've ever left for an Etsy seller in all my years on this site. Don't claim to be an artist in California if you are really operating out of a factory overseas...it's deceptive and wrong. Etsy is for artists and individuals!

Very disappointed with this purchase and disappointed with the seller. I purchased this thinking it was a photoshop, editable file, which it is not. The platform you use for customers to access and edit your creations isn't user friendly and makes printing large volumes very complicated. If you reach out to customers and ask for feedback I feel you should do more when a customer tells you they are unhappy. Would have loved to hear some tips and tricks about making the process easier, instead you brushed me aside in the too hard basket. Thank you for creating lovely designs, but maybe rethink the way in which customers can access them :)

I ordered a printed student planner. The product description said that it would be printed and shipped within 48 hours. It was not shipped out for 13 days. It was sent through FedEx, so I thought I might still get the planner before school started. Nope.

The tracking info showed the book taking a slow drive across the country from Massachusetts (NOT California) before getting lost in Washington State. At which point the tracker showed FedEx relaying the shipping info to the USPS.

Weeks after my order, the shop owner initially shrugged and told me to contact FedEx and the post office to hunt down the package and go get it myself. The order was Refunded only after I opened a case with Etsy and provided them screenshots of the product and shop descriptions and emails showing the timeline.
